svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, the same. Saw 20 x 6 mm bar into 12 mm pieces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the cut ends square: the rear face is where the payload

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shoe stops, so it must be flat and square to the 6 mm face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill one 4.5 mm hole 7 mm from the rear face, 5 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front end and 10 mm from each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: between the plate and the lip, against the spacer bar, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front end of the rail. Its rear face is 12 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both stops line up across the plate within 0.2 mm.
